selected_skill.purpose: Build a durable, source-derived writing style profile from real source material and reuse it across launch, social, email, and changelog content without generic AI tropes.

skillsmp_references.name: brand-voice
skillsmp_references.relevance: Direct match for source-derived voice profile creation and cross-channel reuse.

skillsmp_references.name: content-engine
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent content workflow skill that treats brand-voice as canonical.

skillsmp_references.name: article-writing
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent long-form writing skill for launch and article surfaces.

live_services: local brandroom content archive service serving source corpus, claims, brief, specs, and glossary
environment_design.determinism: Frozen input files and deterministic in-container archive service mirror the same data and write access logs for guardrail verification.
anti_toy_features: multi-channel corpus with articles, docs, changelog, email, and social samples
non-canonical comparator samples that must be excluded from the brand voice profile
approved and forbidden claims separated into explicit business constraints
source-priority grouping and reusable hard-ban anti-pattern checks
service access guardrail so the solver cannot treat the task as a static toy conversion

main_tests: source-backed voice profile coverage and non-generic rules
claim safety and banned phrase scanning
guardrails: pre-verifier access log proves the local archive service was checked
input files and hidden service hashes must remain unchanged
output cannot use fabricated source IDs or claim IDs
generic AI marketing phrases and forbidden claims fail the verifier

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: The task is theoretically solvable, but agents commonly jump directly to channel drafts, write a generic tone guide, miss source-evidence binding, or overuse marketing cliches.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill standardizes the source-priority, voice-profile extraction, hard-ban, and downstream reuse workflow, reducing diagnosis and convergence cost without changing task data or verifier.
